message: Baseline verification passed all 5 public tests. Code has synchronous Runs/Attempts, enabled scheduling flag, 200 job envelopes for state mutations, and 409 JobNotSchedulable responses. No METHOD.md is present. Awaiting product semantics before dependent changes.
